info.title: AuraTune public Artist identity
info.description: User-approved identity-only increment. Catalog operations remain gated. Public identity never depends on auth or catalog success.

get.description: Anonymous read without cookies or bearer. Explicit public visibility; linked users must have is_banned=false. Unlinked public artists qualify. Hidden, unreviewed, banned, dangling and nonexistent are indistinguishable. No persistent cache. No query parameters or request body.

404.description: Unknown or nonpublic Artist; NOT_FOUND, message Artist not found

500.description: Temporary storage/configuration/protocol failure; INTERNAL_ERROR. Retry whole identity, never render demo data or fake empty success.

ArtistId.description: Canonical signed int64 decimal string, additionally checked within -9223372036854775808..9223372036854775807. Never a JSON number.

name.description: Trimmed public artist name; invalid source causes temporary failure.

imageUrl.description: HTTP(S) URL or null; invalid/missing URLs become null. Broken image renders a neutral fallback.

biography.description: Plain text; missing/whitespace-only source becomes null. Render escaped, preserving line breaks.
